Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 canvas. Preserve the guide exactly: three columns FOUR rows, five orthographic views duplicated in upper and lower halves, FRONT BACK LEFT / RIGHT TOP empty. Paint only existing grey silhouettes in exactly their existing positions, sizes, outlines, gaps and openings. Do not redraw, enlarge, move, join separated parts or redesign. Top two rows: unlit base colour faithful to original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style: ornate silver scalloped crescent flat metal piece, small angular rear flat metal piece, gold socket fittings, reddish-brown wood shaft, brown leather wrapped upper grip, gold end cap and gold curved top fitting. Follow HD reference facets engravings scrollwork and inner swirls scaled to each view, but no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights or reflections. Bottom two rows: same silhouettes and material regions as upper half, but FLAT exact material ID colours only: every metal including gold and silver pure red #FF0000; leather/fur pure green #00FF00; cloth/cords/hair pure blue #0000FF; wood/bone/horn/stone/paper/wax pure yellow #FFFF00; gemstone/glass/enamel/liquid pure black #000000. Output the painted guide sheet, not a standalone enlarged object.
